verdict.rationale: The skills CLI ships its own authoring aid, `skills init [name]`, which creates a new SKILL.md template (skills-cli-gh-15, skills-cli-gh-28, skills-cli-gh-43). An install example also names a `skill-creator` skill in the vercel-labs/agent-skills collection (skills-cli-gh-20), but nothing describes what that skill does. Template scaffolding is only a starting point and does not by itself guide an agent through writing, refining and packaging skills. missing for 10: documented contents and behavior of a skill-creator meta-skill, agent-guided iteration or improvement workflow, packaging or publishing guidance, hands-on or independent corroboration.
